solutions.latex:
AP with $a=3300$ and $a+10d=2760$, so $10d=-540$ and $d=-54$.

$3300+54-54n<2115$, so $-54n<-1239$ and $n>22.944\ldots$

$y'=\dfrac{\sec^2x}{\tan x}=\dfrac{1+\tan^2x}{\tan x}=\dfrac{1}{\tan x}+\dfrac{\tan^2x}{\tan x}=\cot x+\tan x=$ RHS

$y'=12x^2-4x^3$ and $y''=24x-12x^2$.

Stationary points: $12x^2-4x^3=0$, $4x^2(3-x)=0$, so $x=0$ and $x=3$: $(0,0)$ and $(3,27)$.

At $x=0$, $y''=0$: possible point of inflexion.

At $(3,27)$, $y''=-36$: maximum turning point.

Points of inflexion: $y''=0$ gives $12x(2-x)=0$, so $x=0$ or $x=2$.

$x=1:\ y''=12$; $x=2:\ y''=0$; $x=2.5:\ y''=-15$. Concavity changes, so $(2,16)$ is a point of inflexion.

$x=-1:\ y''=-36$; $x=0:\ y''=0$; $x=1:\ y''=12$. Concavity changes, so $(0,0)$ is a horizontal point of inflexion.

notes: Pages 0-25 are the clean paper; pages 26-51 are scanned handwritten worked answers with marking annotations, used for the solutions and the MCQ key (answer-sheet page 51 agrees with the circled answers). Section I 10 marks; Section II 90 marks (Q11-18 18, Q19-24 18, Q25-30 18, Q31-35 17, Q36-40 19). Q18 and Q19 each group two unrelated items, so they are stored as 18(a), 18(b), 19(a), 19(b), each with one unlabelled part and src_label a/b (seq runs 1-42). Typos in paper (kept as printed): Q7 'is moving is moving'; Q17(b) says 'blocks' and 'boxes' and 'mean weight' where packets / screws are meant (the marker's handwriting on the solution page corrects them to packets, packets, screws); Q25 'that the dog can play' ungrammatical. Q26 table is stored as a cropped figure. Q16 and Q35(b) blank grids are stored as figures. Q8 Pareto chart may be outside the 2024 Advanced syllabus (borderline, not flagged). Standard-course flags on Q9, Q11, Q24, Q28. Solutions are handwritten and were transcribed from the scans (Q33c printed 2.966; exact sqrt(8.8)=2.9665). Q39(b) interest as written 105 658.49.
